correction.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 changed its chart's Service and ServiceMonitor definitions to refer to ports by name instead of by number. Exposed environments are those whose rendered Service ports or ServiceMonitor endpoints differ between the old and new release when rendered with the environment's own values.
